# 1 Clement Chapter 58 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 58 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_058_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 58

**58:1** Therefore let us be obedient to his all-holy and glorious name, and escape the threats which Wisdom warned of beforehand — that we may dwell secure in the most holy name of his greatness.

**58:2** Receive our counsel, and you will have no regrets. For as God lives, and as the Lord Jesus Christ lives, and the Holy Spirit — who are the faith and hope of the elect — so the one who with humility and unwavering meekness, without regret, has carried out the decrees and commandments given by God shall without doubt be enrolled and reckoned in the number of those saved through Jesus Christ. Through him be glory to God forever and ever. Amen.

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
